'''Priam''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] who was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troska]] with a commendation for [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Treyz Manech]], who had uncovered the corruption of the Kyber family and the rogue Imperial officer [[Sev Buzk]].

==Biography==
===Events on Troska===
[[Troska]] was a minor [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that only warranted a small [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] outpost. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Sev Buzk|Buzk]] was illegally exploiting the natives, for his own personal gain. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Treyz Manech|Manech]] reported Buzk's illegal actions, and developed a plan to expose his corruption and expand the Imperial presence in the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Admiral Priam and her colleagues approved Manech's plan and agreed to grant him the resources needed to carry it out. When it succeeded, the Admiral traveled to Troska to congratulate Manech, and give him new orders.

==Behind the scenes==
Admiral Priam was created by writer [[Jeremy Barlow]], and drawn by [[Francisco Ruiz Velasco]], though was not identified until given an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''. To date, the character has only appeared in ''[[Boba Fett: Overkill]]'', a one-shot comic.
